verdict.rationale: AngelList documents one user-configured background automation: after an admin connects an HRIS/payroll integration, terminations sync into AngelList automatically. It also runs automated system health checks on the cap table. These are fixed, built-in behaviors rather than a general facility for users to define their own autonomous automations. Missing for 10: a user-defined automation/workflow builder, scheduled or recurring custom jobs, agentic or AI-driven autonomous actions beyond the Tie Out mismatch detection, and any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automatically terminate employees in AngelList when employees are terminated in your HRIS/payroll systems.
Navigate to People > Configuration > Integrations and select your provider.
The Health Checks dashboard provides an overview of potential cap table inconsistencies that have been identified through automated system checks.
